mapper.insert: insert into ai_text_to_sql_eval_task( name, business_domain, eval_target, sample_category, status, total_count, pass_count, fail_count, interrupted_count, pass_rate, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{name}, #{businessDomain}, #{evalTarget}, #{sampleCategory}, #{status}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{createdBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update ai_text_to_sql_eval_task set status = 'RUNNING', total_count = #{totalCount}, started_at = now(), error_message = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update ai_text_to_sql_eval_task set status = #{status}, pass_count = #{passCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, interrupted_count = #{interruptedCount}, pass_rate = #{passRate}, finished_at = now(), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update ai_text_to_sql_eval_task set pass_count = #{passCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, interrupted_count = #{interruptedCount}, pass_rate = #{passRate}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
